meta.note: Lafayette Square's listings are curated by hand (content/listings.json, with the conflated src/data/buildings.json), not produced from a base: bake-content bakes this town's roster from them and never writes them; --force regenerates the listings from OSM and says so. Declared here, in the town's own data, so the bake never decides it by the town's name (G4, 2026-10-07).
